summary: Preserve dynamic `this` in inherited JavaScript static methods.

target.notes: Dispatch static methods as JavaScript function-valued properties on constructor objects so `this` is the constructor object used as the call receiver.

caveats: C# static member inheritance does not provide a runtime receiver corresponding to the subclass constructor object.

tests.name: inherited static this
tests.input: class A { static who(){ return this.name; } } class B extends A {} console.log(B.who());

tests.name: edge: extracted static method loses this
tests.input: class A { static who(){ return this; } } const f=A.who; console.log(f()===undefined);
tests.expected_behavior: prints true because class method code is strict
